name: compute round accuracy excluding invalid and unmatched pairs
definition: For each round, compare matching question ids by exact numeric match, drop pairs where either side is an error, and report correct/total with a half-up rounding; return a null accuracy when no valid pairs exist.
failure_mode: Including excluded pairs or a rounding error yields a wrong accuracy.

name: compute the sqrt wasserstein distance from the transport cost
definition: reduce the dot product of plan and cost, root-clamp to non-negative, and return the square root so the result is the actual metric distance.
failure_mode: returning the unrooted squared cost breaks the distance comparison

name: configure a jupyter server via its config file
definition: write the notebook config to override port, listen address, and probe auth settings
failure_mode: missing or malformed config lines fail the file-content checks

name: configure a single-node cluster to listen on a designated port
definition: edit the site and core configuration files so the cluster uses a specific node address with a designated rpc port and complementary namenode/datanode functions.
failure_mode: a miswritten config string fails the textual check or the included config breeds other defects.
